The supply and installation of the above-mentioned work items shall be part of the Contractor's Basic Scope of Works.However, the Employer may,upon its sole discretion during the construction stage, omit the supply and installation of any/orallofthesaidworkitemsfromtheContractor'sScopeofWorks.Insuch case,theContractorshallbeentitledtoreceive10%of thetotalamountof the l coordination.

The coordination scope by the Contractor shall include, but not limited to, provide the quantities take off based on the approved shop drawing, builder work, levelling, civil work, site preparation, storage, security, temporary work and water and power sources.

During construction, and without having any negative impact on the progress of Works as per the approved Programme, the Contractor shall not order any of the said work items before collecting the Employer's decision on direct supply. Any such order without prior approval shall be at the Contractor's risk.
